body.name: Deterministic-diamond worked instance
body.construction: Let \(\mathcal D\) have ordered vertices \(x\prec r\prec a\prec b\prec c\prec y\), intervention \(X=\{x\}\), outcome \(Y=\{y\}\), deterministic directed edges \(r\to a,r\to b,a\to c,b\to c,c\to y\), uncertain edges \(e_1=x\to r\) and \(e_2=x\leftrightarrow r\), and query \(P_x(y)\).
